arguments.command:
set -eu
BASE=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp
PY="$BASE/envs/openwebui/bin/python"
"$PY" - <<'PY'
import sqlite3,json,urllib.request,subprocess
BASE="/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp"
db=BASE+"/openwebui-data/webui.db"
c=sqlite3.connect("file:"+db+"?mode=ro",uri=True); c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row; c.execute("pragma query_only=on")
cfg={}
for k in ("task.model.default","task.model.external","task.model.params","models.default_params"):
 r=c.execute('select value,updated_at from config where "key"=?',(k,)).fetchone(); cfg[k]=dict(r) if r else None
print("TASK_CONFIG="+json.dumps(cfg,separators=(",",":")))
ids=[]
for k in ("task.model.default","task.model.external"):
 r=cfg.get(k)
 if r:
  try: ids.append(json.loads(r["value"]))
  except Exception: pass
for mid in sorted(set(x for x in ids if isinstance(x,str))):
 r=c.execute("select id,name,base_model_id,params,is_active,updated_at from model where id=?",(mid,)).fetchone()
 print("BOUND_MODEL="+json.dumps(dict(r) if r else None,separators=(",",":"),default=str))
rows=c.execute("select id,name,base_model_id,params,is_active,updated_at from model where is_active=1 and base_model_id is not null and base_model_id!='' order by id").fetchall()
print("ACTIVE_DERIVED_MODELS="+json.dumps([dict(r) for r in rows],separators=(",",":"),default=str))
print("DB_INTEGRITY="+c.execute("pragma integrity_check").fetchone()[0]); c.close()
with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags",timeout=5) as r:
 tags=json.load(r)
 print("OLLAMA_TAG_NAMES="+json.dumps([m.get("name") for m in tags.get("models",[])],separators=(",",":")))
with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/ps",timeout=5) as r: print("OLLAMA_PS="+json.dumps(json.load(r),separators=(",",":")))
pid=subprocess.check_output(["pgrep","-f",BASE+"/miniconda/bin/ollama serve"],text=True).splitlines()[0]
env=open("/proc/"+pid+"/environ","rb").read().split(b"\0")
keys=(b"OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=",b"OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=",b"OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=",b"OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=",b"OLLAMA_NUM_THREAD=",b"OLLAMA_MAX_QUEUE=")
vals=sorted(x.decode(errors="replace") for x in env if x.startswith(keys))
print("OLLAMA_ENV="+json.dumps(vals,separators=(",",":")))
PY
echo -n "WARM_CRON_COUNT="
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -F -c "$BASE/runtime-domains/automation/warm-residency.sh" || true
